objects.original: The pointwise representative of projected noise with measurable temperature.
objects.reconstructed: Put E=Euclidean R^I, S={x:||x||=1}, and V_j(x)=e_j-x_j*x, so [V_j(x)]_i=delta_ij-x_j*x_i. Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T). The named constructor local_symbol_e7713243b878 packages the process sqrt(2*a(t))*[V_j(X(t,omega))]_i together with its progressive and L^2 proofs.
objects.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/SphereMeasurableCoordinateSDE.lean:59; The body of sphereMeasurableNoiseIntegrand is visible in the complete module and stores the literal coefficient.
